tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: Lists the connections and databases that you can query, with your tier on each database. Call this tool first. Use only the names that it returns. `maxTier` is the highest tier that QueryHub accepts. `resultMode` tells what you can read of a result.

tools.name: describe_database
tools.description: Returns the table names in a database. If you pass `table`, it returns the columns of the tables whose names contain that text.

table.description: Part of a table name. Optional.

tools.name: classify_sql
tools.description: Returns the tier that a statement needs, and whether QueryHub accepts the statement. This tool is optional. `queryhub_submit_query` does the same checks.

tools.name: submit_query
tools.description: Submits one statement for the person. If QueryHub auto-approves the statement, the tool waits for the result. Put no personal data and no secret in the statement. Show the person `requestUrl`. A person always approves a write (RW) and a schema change (DDL). If `decision` is `needs_approval`, poll `queryhub_query_status`. Do not submit the same statement again. If QueryHub refuses the statement, read the reason and change the statement.

justification.description: Why the person needs this data.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result. Default 20. Maximum 20.

tools.name: query_status
tools.description: Returns the status of a request that you submitted. Approval takes minutes, so poll this tool. Do not submit the statement again. Show the person `requestUrl`.

tools.name: fetch_result
tools.description: Returns the row count and the column names of a completed request. While `resultMode` is `metadata_only`, you read no rows. Tell the person to open `requestUrl` to see the result. Do not ask the person to paste the result. Only in `masked_rows` mode does it also return a page of rows.

offset.description: The first row to return. Default 0. Used in `masked_rows` mode only.

limit.description: How many rows. Default 50. Maximum 200. Used in `masked_rows` mode only.
